 Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No.53 of 2023, pending in the Court of the learned S.D.J.M., Patnagarh, arising out of Belapada P.S. Case No.0008 of 2023, for alleged commission of offences under Sections 420/294/506 of IPC.
3.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Sessions Judge, Patnagarh, by order dated 13.02.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 27.01.2023 on the accusation that he has taken cotton seeds and fertilizers from the informant on credit basis worth of which was around Rs.6,00,000/-(Rupees six lakhs) with the assurance that he will return the same in the month of December.
Since, the petitioner did not return the same, FIR has been lodged.

5. It is stated that since charge sheet has been filed on 28.02.2023 and considering the nature of allegations more so keeping in view his age, he may be released on bail.
6.
Learned counsel for the State, on instruction, submits that the petitioner has criminal antecedent of similar nature.
Hence, he ought not to be released on bail.

8. Additionally, it is directed that the petitioner shall furnish cash security to the tune of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees two lakhs) which shall be kept in a short term interest bearing account subject to the outcome of the case at hand.
9. It is further directed that the petitioner shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction of the learned Court in seisin without its express permission.
